parameters.command: =V=/tmp/kazm-introvo.mp3; B=/tmp/kazm-introbed.mp3; O=/tmp/kazm-intromix.mp3; SE="{{ $('Unpack the intro voice').first().json.speechEnd }}"; FF=/home/node/.n8n/bin/ffmpeg; if [ -s "$B" ]; then E=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+0.3}"); E2=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+1.5}"); T=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+4.0}"); FST=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+1.2}"); $FF -y -i "$V" -i "$B" -filter_complex "[0:a]adelay=3000|3000,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo[v];[1:a]atrim=0:$T,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,volume='if(lt(t,2.4),0.50,if(lt(t,3.0),0.50-0.33*(t-2.4)/0.6,if(lt(t,$E),0.17,if(lt(t,$E2),0.17+0.28*(t-$E)/1.2,0.45))))':eval=frame[b];[b][v]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0,afade=t=in:d=1.0,afade=t=out:st=$FST:d=2.8" -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k "$O" >/tmp/kazm-intromix.log 2>&1 && echo MIXED || { echo MIXFAIL; tail -3 /tmp/kazm-intromix.log; cp "$V" "$O"; }; else cp "$V" "$O"; echo DRY; fi; rm -f "$B"

parameters.command: =V=/tmp/kazm-outrovo.mp3; B=/tmp/kazm-outrobed.mp3; O=/tmp/kazm-outromix.mp3; SE="{{ $('Unpack the outro voice').first().json.speechEnd }}"; FF=/home/node/.n8n/bin/ffmpeg; if [ -s "$B" ]; then E=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+0.3}"); E2=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+1.5}"); T=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+8.0}"); FST=$(awk "BEGIN{print 3.0+$SE+4.0}"); $FF -y -i "$V" -ss 62 -i "$B" -filter_complex "[0:a]adelay=3000|3000,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo[v];[1:a]atrim=0:$T,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,volume='if(lt(t,2.4),0.50,if(lt(t,3.0),0.50-0.33*(t-2.4)/0.6,if(lt(t,$E),0.17,if(lt(t,$E2),0.17+0.28*(t-$E)/1.2,0.45))))':eval=frame[b];[b][v]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0,afade=t=in:d=1.0,afade=t=out:st=$FST:d=4.0" -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k "$O" >/tmp/kazm-outromix.log 2>&1 && echo MIXED || { echo MIXFAIL; tail -3 /tmp/kazm-outromix.log; cp "$V" "$O"; }; else cp "$V" "$O"; echo DRY; fi; rm -f "$B"

parameters.command: =V=/tmp/kazm-qsvo-vo.mp3; B=/tmp/kazm-qsvo-bed.mp3; O=/tmp/kazm-qsvo-mix.mp3; DOMIX="{{ $('Pick a QS bed').first().json.doMix }}"; SS0="{{ $('Unpack the break voice').first().json.speechStart }}"; SE="{{ $('Unpack the break voice').first().json.speechEnd }}"; FF=/home/node/.n8n/bin/ffmpeg; if [ "$DOMIX" = "true" ] && [ -s "$B" ]; then W=$(awk "BEGIN{print 1.5+$SS0}"); DS=$(awk "BEGIN{d=1.5+$SS0-0.6; if (d<0.3) d=0.3; print d}"); FO=$(awk "BEGIN{print 1.5+$SE+0.5}"); T=$(awk "BEGIN{print 1.5+$SE+2.8}"); $FF -y -i "$V" -i "$B" -filter_complex "[0:a]adelay=1500|1500,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo[v];[1:a]aloop=loop=-1:size=2e9,atrim=0:$T,aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,volume='if(lt(t,$DS),0.40,if(lt(t,$W),0.40-0.24*(t-$DS)/($W-$DS),0.16))':eval=frame[b];[b][v]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0,afade=t=in:d=0.8,afade=t=out:st=$FO:d=2.2" -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 160k "$O" >/tmp/kazm-qsvo-mix.log 2>&1 && echo "MIXED bed" || { echo MIXFAIL; tail -3 /tmp/kazm-qsvo-mix.log; cp "$V" "$O"; }; else cp "$V" "$O"; echo DRY; fi; rm -f "$B"
